{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d3e5142c.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Extract each nonzero 3x3 object and arrange them left-to-right in a single row band.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = {(r, c)}
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen
                            and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        cells.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            pattern = [[grid[y][x] for x in range(minc, maxc + 1)]
                       for y in range(minr, maxr + 1)]
            objects.append((minc, pattern))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    out = [[0] * (len(objects) * 3 + max(0, len(objects) - 1)) for _ in range(3)]
    for i, (_, pattern) in enumerate(objects):
        offset = i * 4
        for y in range(3):
            for x in range(3):
                out[y][offset + x] = pattern[y][x]
    return out
